subject: Web Development
title: Layout: Box Model Math
description: A 60-second lesson on Layout: Box Model Math.

hook.text: Every element on a web page is a rectangular box. No exceptions.

buildup.text: The box model wraps content in padding, a border, and margin — layers like an onion.

discovery.text: The browser calculates exact pixel positions for thousands of boxes in milliseconds.

twist.text: One CSS change can trigger layout for the entire page, recalculating every box position.

climax.text: Developers call it 'reflow.' It's the most expensive operation a browser performs.

punchline.text: The web is made of invisible boxes.

quiz.question: What is the most expensive rendering operation?
